highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159 will introduce an experimental package for comparing rendered images and diagnosing differences.
highlights_body: SkiaSharp.Testing will provide configurable image comparisons and visual diagnostics. This release will also stop including Linux x86 native assets; affected deployments must move to a supported architecture.

breaking.title: Migrate Linux x86 deployments before upgrading
breaking.body: NuGet packages will no longer include Linux x86 native assets, following upstream .NET's removal of Linux x86 cross-build infrastructure. Move 32-bit x86 Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: The new SkiaSharp.Testing package adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and MAE, RMS and PSNR metrics. Its APIs are experimental: opt in by suppressing diagnostic SKIA4001 through NoWarn or a pragma.

Generate binary masks, channel differences, threshold maps, overlays and heatmaps using the same tolerance and masking rules as comparison. Returned difference images are independent, caller-owned SKImage instances that callers must dispose; comparison results retain no native handles.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and its view projects to the Windows samples solution.
